newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: MOTORCYCLING-GERMAN SIDECAR DUO INJURED IN CRASH.
newsitem.headline: MOTORCYCLING-GERMAN SIDECAR DUO INJURED IN CRASH.

text.p: German duo Markus Neumann and Peter Hoess were injured when their sidecar crashed into the pit wall and caught fire during qualifying on Friday ahead of Sunday's Austrian Grand Prix.
Officials at the A1-Ring said Neumann suffered light injuries in the chest area while passenger Hoess broke his left arm.
Track marshalls were able to extinguish the flames immediately and both men were taken to hospital in nearby Knittelfeld.
The incident caused the first of two sidecar qualifying sessions to be red-flagged to a halt.
Switzerland's Paul and Charly Guedel posted the fastest time of 1:36.572 when the session was restarted.
